questions.question: What Shopify work do you usually take on?
questions.answer: Usually one of four things: custom theme work, Online Store 2.0 migrations, storefront feature development or ongoing support after launch.

questions.question: Can you work inside an existing Shopify store?
questions.answer: Yes. I regularly work inside live Shopify stores: sections, product pages, cart, filtering, integrations and speed.

questions.question: Do you handle migrations to Shopify Online Store 2.0?
questions.answer: Yes. I move stores from a legacy setup to OS 2.0, keep the content structure and rebuild custom logic.

questions.question: Can you help after launch too?
questions.answer: Yes. Many clients keep me on after launch for fixes, experiments, SEO, speed and new sections.

questions.question: How do we start?
questions.answer: Send the store URL, the task and any deadlines. I then suggest the next step: an audit, a small sprint or a larger implementation.

questions.question: Do you work with designers or existing specs?
questions.answer: Yes. I build from Figma, Loom videos, written specs or an existing storefront reference. If requirements are still rough, I help structure them.

anatomy.title: From first call to first sale
anatomy.lead: Every project goes through the same six steps. Your live store keeps selling while I build.

layers.title: Kick-off call
layers.text: On Google Meet we go through your store, goals and deadline. You get scope, timeline and price before any work starts.

layers.title: Brief & design
layers.text: Everything goes into a written brief: pages, features, apps and content. Then a Figma design, or your own design, prototype or Lovable file, checked against the brief.

layers.title: Build in Shopify sections
layers.text: I build on a preview theme, so the live store keeps selling. Every section comes with settings your team can change later without code.

layers.title: QA testing
layers.text: Every page on real phones and browsers, cart and checkout, speed and translations, checked against the brief before you see it.

layers.title: SEO setup
layers.text: Titles, meta, structured data, redirects from the old URLs and a clean sitemap, so the new store keeps the traffic of the old one.

layers.title: Analytics & launch
layers.text: GA4, Meta and Klaviyo events wired in and tested. I publish after your approval and stay on for fixes and next steps.

aboutPage.title: About Kiril Karatitsyn
aboutPage.lead: I am an e-commerce solutions expert based in Bad Bentheim, Germany. I help Shopify stores that sell across Europe with speed, conversion and automation, mostly remote.
aboutPage.whatText: I make slow stores faster, find where visitors drop off before they buy, and automate what the team still does by hand. I build custom Shopify themes, set up Markets for new countries and move stores to Shopify from WooCommerce and other systems. I own the whole task, from the first look at the store to the fixes after launch. I also host E-commerce Coffee Meetings, small meetups for people who sell online.
